name: Perseverance traverse and localised waypoints
notes: From https://mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/M20/Layers/json/M20_traverse.json and https://mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/M20/Layers/json/M20_waypoints.json. The drive is thinned to one point every 2 m, and segments the source repeats for drives that ran over several sols are kept once, so the drawn line is a little shorter than the rover's odometry in the waypoints. Heights are metres above the Mars areoid. Covers sols 13 to 2022 (45.246 km).
